title: Number of Provinces
statement: `is_connected` is an n by n adjacency matrix of an undirected graph. Return the number of connected components, called provinces.
hints: DFS or BFS from every unvisited city counts a component.
Union-find unions cities that share an edge and then counts roots.
Skip the diagonal. It is a self-loop, not a new edge.

approaches.name: Disjoint set
approaches.explanation: Union every edge, then count parents that point at themselves.

editorial: A province is a connected component. The DFS version marks a city visited and recurses through every neighbor whose matrix entry is 1. The number of times you start a search is the number of provinces.

examples.explanation: Cities 0 and 1 are connected. City 2 is alone.
